town_description: Naharlagun is a town in Papum Pare district, Arunachal Pradesh, adjacent to the state capital Itanagar and part of the Itanagar Capital Complex. It is the main commercial and transport hub of the capital region, with Naharlagun railway station linking Arunachal to the rest of India. Its known temples include Shiv Mandir, Shiv Hanuman Mandir (D Sector), Kali Mandir (E Sector), Jain Mandir and Naam Ghar.

travel.road: Naharlagun is on NH 415, about 15 km from Itanagar (verify).
